text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the race, Hokko Tarumae 
was filled with an unprecedented sense of 
fulfillment, having run purely on her 
desire to shine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reaching that pinnacle was all thanks to 
Smart Falcon. Wanting to repay her, the 
Trainer proposed a way to show their 
gratitude—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing Smart Falcon. Standing at the 
pinnacle of both regional and central 
circuits as a dirt Umamusume, while aiming 
to be the top local idol as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Around that time, her entry into the "Big 
Bang Idol Fest" was decided. If she 
delivers results at this fest, she'll 
truly become the top local idol in both 
name and deed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And for her other goal— to claim the 
summit of dirt Umamusume— Hokko Tarumae 
takes on the Teio Sho!
